artifacts.summary: Eight-phase lean4 plan porting report 03's naming-rule soundness toolkit (two-way bounded morphisms, L-plus invariance, IRR rule, clock rule, auxiliary-atoms expansion) into HistoryMorphism.lean and a new Metalogic/NamingRules.lean.

memory_candidates.content: Before planning a port of a standalone Mathlib-only probe into this Lean library, grep the library for the probe's CONSTRUCTIONS, not just its theorem names. Probe 03 of the nondeterministic-canonical-model work reconstructed a 'clock product' digraph from scratch under a build embargo; the library already had FrameOver.translationProduct (FormalSystem/Semantics/Frames/TranslationProduct.lean) carrying every fact the probe derived -- regularity, frame-class preservation, clock_eq, plus_invariance, and translationProductProj : HistMorphism -- and over an arbitrary duration group rather than only the integers. Two of four deliverables collapsed to zero construction work. The dual lesson: the library's HistMorphism structure took the probe's derived 'lift' as a primitive FIELD, so the genuinely novel content was deriving that field from forth/back, not restating the invariance. Probe-to-library ports are reliably mis-scoped in BOTH directions at once -- some items are already present under a different name, while the item that looks like a restatement is the real work.
